title: Give Batch52 telemetry teardown a meaningful strict-cleanup contract
outcome: Batch52 telemetry tests either exercise a real fixture-owned artifact/handle before strict deletion or use tolerant cleanup when only an empty temp directory exists.
acceptance: The chosen cleanup mode remains deterministic under the full Windows gate.
The six Batch52 telemetry tests no longer present strict deletion of an always-empty root as handle-release evidence.
